# Incident report: checkout payment failures (2026-11-05)

**Severity:** SEV1. checkout-web error rate was 17.6%. Any checkout failure rate above 10% is SEV1.
**Status:** Mitigated and verified at 14:30 UTC.

## Timeline (UTC)
- 13:41: payments-api v2.14.0 deployed (dep_7781). Health stayed OK afterwards (p99 412 ms at 13:55), so this deploy is not the cause.
- 14:02: release-train ramped flag `tax_engine_v2` from 10% to 100% (flg_2210). TaxEngineV2 calls tax-service /v2/quote.
- 14:02: payments-api p99 latency went from 420 ms to 3150 ms. TaxEngineV2 calls began timing out after 3000 ms, and POST /charge started returning 502 "tax quote unavailable".
- 14:03: checkout-web error rate went from 0.3% to 17.6%. Its logs show "payment step failed: payments-api 502".
- 14:05: search-api v5.2.1 deployed (dep_7790). This came after the errors started, on a different service, and checkout-web errors don't point to it. I took no action on it.
- 14:07:44: a payments-api DEBUG log line recorded an outbound Authorization bearer token. Security was paged. The secret is not reproduced here.
- 14:27: Status page updated to "identified".
- ~14:27: `tax_engine_v2` set back to its previous rollout of 10%. Paged payments, storefront and security.
- 14:30: checkout-web error rate was 0.4% and payments-api p99 was 450 ms. Status page updated to "mitigated".

## Root cause
Change flg_2210 sent all checkout traffic through TaxEngineV2. Its calls to tax-service /v2/quote timed out at 3 s, so payments-api returned 502 on /charge and checkout failed.

## Mitigation
Set `tax_engine_v2` back to 10%. I chose the flag revert over a rollback, as the runbook prefers, and did not roll back any deploys.

## Verification
- checkout-web error rate: 17.6% before, 0.4% at 14:30 (under the 1% threshold).
- payments-api p99 latency: 3150 ms before, 450 ms after.

## Follow-ups
1. Security / payments: rotate the tax-service credential that appeared in payments-api logs, purge the affected logs, and stop logging request headers at DEBUG.
2. Payments / tax: find out why tax-service /v2/quote can't handle full traffic before ramping again. Ramp gradually and set automatic rollback guards.
3. Payments: decide whether the 10% still on TaxEngineV2 should go to 0%. Those requests may still fail occasionally, but the overall error rate is under 1%.
4. Search team: look into the separate search-api p95 latency warning (alt_33), which may relate to dep_7790. It is not tied to the checkout failures.
